svg.title: Dreams name review and code extraction
svg.desc: 27 of 9551 function names checked; code extracted for 9508 of 9551 functions. Both panels show every discovered function once in the same order. Each square is one function, with identical cell size and scale. Cached pseudocode does not verify behavior.

g.text: Names checked, unclear cases and code still to review
Each square = one function. Both panels use the same order and scale.
